verdict.rationale: Framer's native External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor and Codex direct access to the canvas, components, CMS and project context without a separate MCP server, and a Server API exists. However, the documentation frames this mainly as agents editing the Framer project (on a branch) rather than extracting design context to implement it in an external codebase. Missing for 10: documented read access to design variables/tokens, screenshot export, component-to-code mappings, any published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
